content: Imanmii a Kↄlↄnԑlyↄ u Sԑzarԑ
U Sԑzarԑ kàkäl anà mbuur mwԑy ikↄb ande Kↄlↄnԑlyↄ. Nde kàkäl kaptԑn a iköŋ a aŋità a Lↄmà bàfàbel naa « iköŋ a Itali. »
Nde kàkäl anà inzaam, nde anà ywar ande lanswà bàweemà Nzam bɔɔmà. Nde kàfabayà baar mbɔɔn anà kàfayamà Nzam taaŋ lanswà.
Ilä mwԑy, u ntsü a taaŋ làtär ungö a midi, nde kàmԑn ubwaŋàbwaŋ unsà imanmii un'kyeey a Nzam mwԑy kan'yàbilà u ndwà ande, waa kan'tɛn a nde naa: « Kↄlↄnԑlyↄ! »
Kɔlɔnɛlyɔ kun'ler a lää, kun'wem bↄↄmà, waa kun'fuul naa: « Mwol, ininà abi? » Un'kyeey waa kun'fuur naa: « Ngyamàkà angye anà nkääb angye yàkyàbeenà u mii a Nzam, nde waa kan'yɔbà ya.
Wɛɛ apanà, tↄm baar u Yↄpԑ mukàbel mbuur mwɛy ikɔb ande Simↄn, bàfun'bel Petↄlà.
Nde afàbɔ̈ɔ̈n u ndwà a mbuur mwԑy ikɔb ande Simↄn, nde wà un'kwaam a ibaan a ntsür. Ndwà ande yà kà un'kɔɔl a ngyäl a kölàköl. »
Ungö a nkyeen a un'kyeey kàyun'kyään ndaa ayi, Kↄlↄnԑlyↄ kàbel asyääl ande abɔ̈ɔ̈l anà ŋità mwԑy kàkäl anà inzaam anà kàkäl wàŋàbääb anà nde taaŋ mbɔɔn.
Ungö mukakyään indiir byanswà byalyaaŋ, nde katöm Yↄpԑ.
U taaŋtyà, ba bàkäl u mbwo, tsütsü a Yↄpԑ, Petɔlà kàlär kà ikal bàfàyöör mper a midi ntↄn muyamà.
Nde kàwem ngyal, waa kàkwen mudyà. Mpal bàkäl ba mukun'läämà isaa, nde kàmԑn imanmii.
Nde kàmԑn du lan'dubà, undiir mwԑy asànaa yar a ipfԑy a kölàköl làŋàbääm in'siŋ kà an'twɛrà man'nà, lan'yàtyà anà lan'yàtↄlà u mԑԑn.
Uboo a la yàkäl anà ntsür a ifà ifà: ntsür a in'kɔl in'nà, ntsür ifilaan u mԑԑn anà nԑn a du.
Ndaa mwԑy yàtɛn a nde naa: « Petↄlà, mbarà, dwa anà dyà! »
Wԑԑ Petɔlà kàfuur naa: « Mwol, ikwo anki akà ikikye, ntɔn mԑ ŋàtàdyà anki undiir wanswà wàlàbiin anà wàŋingyäy. »
Wɛɛ nde an'fàwem ndaa mbalà yàyweel: « Ngye, twon an'bel ŋingyäy indiir kan'pööŋ Nzam. »
Ya yàkɔlà mbalà tär, ungö apan, undiir awun bàfuur u du.
Petↄlà kàkäl unsà lingyoomà anà muyweerà nde ŋakwo naa imanmii kàmԑn nde ki ikaswaŋà aben. Kyekà taaŋ nsil alan, baar kàtöm Kↄlↄnԑlyↄ bàkäl u munàmbwo bàmufuulà ndwà a Simↄn.
Ba bàbel u ndaa a ngwal, waa bàfuul naa: « Nkye Simↄn awà bàfàbel naa Petↄlà afàbɔ̈ɔ̈n apà? »
Apan Petↄlà kàkäl mukayweerà u mpem ande ntↄn imanmii akyà kàmԑn nde ki, Dweelà kàtɛn a nde naa: « Le, baar atär bàmukaleŋà.
Mbarà, tyà, kyen mbwo mwԑy anà ba ukɔɔn nkyɛɛr, ntↄn ba mԑ, mɛ amatↄm. »
Undiir awun, Petↄlà kàtɔlà nde, waa kàtɛn a baar aban naa: « Le, mԑ in'wà mbuur làleŋà bԑ. Ntɔn nkye làyi bɛ? »

Ba bàtɛn naa: « Kaptɛn Kↄlↄnԑlyↄ kàmitↄm. Nde wà mbuur mwԑy wà balàbal anà afàtiin Nzam bɔɔmà. Nde sye we anà imbäl aŋàbwaŋ akà un'sԑŋ a Ayudà wanswà. Un'kyeey in'kyɛɛl mwԑy kun'swԑŋ naa nde akyer ayabel u ndwà ande, ntↄn ngye awem ndaa awà nde ayà mukakyään. »
Apan, Petɔlà waa kabiil anà kapɛ ikal abɔ̈ɔ̈n. Taaŋtyà nde kàkyen anà ba mbwo mwɛy anà atɔŋ amwɛy bà Yɔpɛ.
Kà ilä kyàlääb, nde kàkɔlà Sɛzarɛ. Kɔlɔnɛlyɔ awà kàkäl mudilà ba, kàbel ywar ande anà asam ande bànkwen.
Umpal kàkɔlà Petɔlà, Kɔlɔnɛlyɔ kàyàbwey anà nde, waa kàbü kà in'kↄl ande ntɔn mukun'sà làkoo.
Petɔlà waa kumbaar, kàtɛn a nde naa: « Mbarà, ntↄn mԑ, mɛ sye in'wà kàmɛ mbuur. »
Apan, Petↄlà kàkäl muyiyääm a Kↄlↄnԑlyↄ umpal kàbilà nde u ndwà, waa kàmԑn baar mbɔɔn bàkyàköŋ.

Nde kàtɛn a ba naa: « Bԑ, bԑ làkyàyöb naa wà ikin naa un'yudà mwԑy utüüb itàkal usin tsütsü apà ungyey. Wԑԑ mԑ, Nzam kan'mɛɛy naa twon an'tɛn a mbuur naa nde wà làbiin itàkal naa ŋingyäy.
Undiir awun, mԑ an'yà mԑ ukɔↄn asà impeen u làbeel angye. Wɛɛ apanà, mԑ in'kwen muyöb ntɔn atöm ngye baar muyan'bel. »
Apan Kↄlↄnԑlyↄ kàtɛn a nde naa: « Ŋàbà ilä kyànà, mԑ kàkäl u ngyamàkà u ndwà amԑ, u taaŋ làtär ungö a midi, wɛɛ le, mbuur mwԑy kàkyàbwaar ipfԑy a iŋyäŋ akyàmbar kusà a mԑ,
nde kan'kyään naa: "Kↄlↄnԑlyↄ, Nzam akyàwem ngyamàkà angye, anà akyàyɔbà nkääb angye.
Tↄm baar u Yↄpԑ mukàbel Simↄn awà bàfàbeel Petↄlà. Nde wà u ndwà a Simↄn un'kwaam a ibaan a ntsür. Ndwà ande yà kà un'kↄↄl a ngyäl."
Làgyägyä, mԑ waa atööm baar muyabel. Ngye, ngye waa akyey muyà. Apanà bi, bi banswà ibà kusà a Nzam ntↄn muwem indiir byanswà kaswɛŋ Mwol. »
Ndaa a Petↄlà u ndwà a Kↄlↄnԑlyↄ
Abun, Petↄlà kàduub mun mutԑn naa: « Mԑ in'kyàyöb ndandaa naa Nzam un'kↄl aŋàyↄŋ afàkyer anki,
wԑԑ unsà un'sɛŋ wanswà, mbuur afun'man bɔɔmà anà afàkyer ndaa a balàbal, nde akyer afun'kyey.
Nde kàtöm ndaa ande akà un'sԑŋ a Isàlԑl, mukyään Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ là duu u mbwo a Yԑsu Klistↄ awà Mwol a baar banswà.
Bԑ, bԑ làkyàyöb ndaa yàsԑmà u Ngalilԑ anà yàpää u Yuday lanswà ungö a ndüümà kàlↄɔŋà Ywan.

Bԑ, bɛ làkyàyöb naa Nzam kàtsüül Dweelà In'kyɛɛl anà kàpɛ ngwal udu a Yɛsu un'nsi Nasàlɛr awà kàyilyaaŋà mukyer ubwaŋ anà mukɔɔr baar bàkäl uboo a ikɔ̈b a Satanà, ntɔn Nzam kàkäl anà nde.
Anà bi sye, bi ibà ambäl a indiir byanswà kàkyer nde u mɛɛn a Ayudà anà u Yɛlusàlɛm. Nde sye wà mbuur bàdwä ba anà bàbɛɛrà ba u kulunsi,
wɛɛ Nzam kun'wiiy kilä kyàtär, waa kun'pɛ mbwo muyàmɛnà,
kakun'sԑŋ wanswà anki, wԑԑ akà bi, bi baar abà kàsɔ̈ɔ̈l Nzam kusà asànaa ambäl, bi baar kàdi anà kànü anà nde ungö a ngwiiyà ande uboo a akü.
Apan Yɛsu kà iswԑŋ mukyään un'sԑŋ anà mutà imbäl naa Nzam nde kàsɔ̈ɔ̈l mukal nkalsà a baar a mɔ̈ɔ̈ anà akü.
Aŋangↄↄm banswà bun'tɛɛl imbäl, mutɛn naa mbuur wanswà asun'wal anà asàsà làkwikilà amu nde, bàsun'dwääl nkul a man'be ande u mbwo a ikɔ̈b a Ikↄb ande. »
Baar mpa abà Ayudà ban'wal Dweelà In'kyɛԑl
Umpal kàkäl Petↄlà mutɛɛnà ndaa ayi, Dweelà In'kyɛԑl kàbü udu a baar banswà bàweemà ndaa kàlↄɔŋà nde.
Wԑԑ aŋàlàkwikilà bàŋàkyɛy abà bàyi mbwo mwԑy anà Petↄlà bàkäl unsà ubem muman naa Dweelà In'kyɛԑl kàpää sye udu a baar mpa abà Ayudà.
Abun, ba bàweemà naa ba bàmutԑɛnà u ndaa a ingyey anà bàmusyäŋà Nzam. Apan, Petↄlà kàtԑn naa:
« Taaŋ alà, nkye we anà mbuur kan'kwo mutsuŋ an'dà a ndüümà akà baar ban'wal Dweelà In'kyɛԑl bà asànaa bi? »
Apan, nde kàswԑŋ naa badümà kà ikↄb a Yԑsu Klistↄ. Ba bun'lɔ̈ɔ̈m naa nde ubwaay ndam a ilä apà ba.
